Build a governed M2 offset-subset configuration

Source: R/m2_subset_correction.R
m2_subset_config.Rd

Build a governed M2 offset-subset configuration

Usage

m2_subset_config(
  h1 = NULL,
  h2 = NULL,
  alpha_state = 0.2,
  bs = "ts",
  method = "REML",
  gamma = 1.4,
  intercept_sp = -1
)

Arguments

h1, h2

Selected per-horizon specifications (one-row data frames, lists, or NULL for the all-off default).

alpha_state

EMA decay used to build the `z`/`d` features, in (0, 1).

bs

Basis type; only `"ts"` is supported.

method

GAM fitting method.

gamma

Smoothness selection multiplier (>= 1).

intercept_sp

Horizon-intercept penalty; -1 estimates it by REML.

Value

A validated configuration list tagged with the `offset_subset_v1` family.
